faqs.question: How long does it take to launch a new website?
faqs.answer: Most Snap Load Digital projects launch within 7 business days after we receive your content and brand details. Larger multi-page sites may take up to two weeks.

faqs.question: Do you only work with businesses in Great Bend?
faqs.answer: We specialize in Great Bend and Central Kansas, but we work remotely with small businesses across Kansas. Every site includes local SEO setup tailored to your service area.

faqs.question: What SEO is included with every website?
faqs.answer: Every build includes optimized title tags and meta descriptions, canonical URLs, structured data (JSON-LD), a sitemap, robots.txt, semantic HTML, and local business schema so Google can understand your location and services.

faqs.question: Will my website score 100 on Google Lighthouse?
faqs.answer: Yes — we engineer every site for 100 Lighthouse scores in Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO using static HTML, purged CSS, and no bloated page builders.

faqs.question: Do I own my website after launch?
faqs.answer: With the Own It Outright plan, you own the site from day one. With Launch & Support, you get full use of the site while subscribed; we can discuss ownership transfer anytime.
